summary: 22nd Century Group commenced a warrant inducement offering, agreeing to issue Inducement Warrants for 100% of shares exercised by holders of Existing Warrants (5,345,591 shares at $3.57) at a reduced exercise price of $0.4626. All Existing Warrants must be exercised immediately for cash. Inducement Warrants will be exercisable after stockholder approval, expire in five years, and include anti-dilution adjustments. The company will file a resale registration statement by June 30, 2026. Watch for stockholder meeting outcome and potential dilution from full exercise; risk-arb angle centers on the steep discount and share overhang.
